name: Elena de Arcadare
original_name: エレナ・ド・アークアデア
source: Elena is a 4th Arcadare princess. She looks phlegmatic, but in fact she has a subtle sense of humor, although sometimes she just fools around. For a long time, Elena has been trying to summon someone from the magic circle, and Mamoru have to play the role of a sacrifice for her rituals. When it comes to Sacred Orb extracting, Elena spares no efforts to arouse Mamoru in the most fetishistic ways. Also, Elena is a vessel for Rain, the strong demon, that was sealed inside her body.
